description: IF Console: the secondary interface of every repository's command line. Commands, checks, findings, previews and decisions in VS Code, through each repository's own launcher.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces.descrip: IF Console runs each repository's own command line, so it runs nothing in a workspace you have not trusted.
capabilities.virtualWorkspaces.descripti: IF Console runs a command line that lives in a clone on this machine.

welcome.home.0:
No folder in this window declares a command line for IF Console. A repository declares its own with a `.if-console.env` file at its root, or you can name a launcher yourself in your settings.
[Refresh](command:if-console.refresh)
[Name a launcher in settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22if-console.launchers%22%5D)
welcome.home.1:
This workspace is not trusted, so IF Console runs nothing. Trusting it is a decision only you can make.
[Trust this workspace](command:if-console.trust)
welcome.home.2:
A command line was found but it did not start, so there is nothing to show yet. The output says why.
[Show Output](command:if-console.showOutput)
[Refresh](command:if-console.refresh)
welcome.home.3:
A command line was found but a program or library it needs is not on this machine yet. Run its `doctor` command in a terminal to see which, and the command that fetches it.
[Open a terminal](command:workbench.action.terminal.new)
[Show Output](command:if-console.showOutput)
[Refresh](command:if-console.refresh)

configuration.title: IF Console
setting.launchers.description: Launcher file names to try at the root of a workspace folder that declares none in its own `.if-console.env`. Only your own user settings are read; a workspace cannot name what IF Console runs.
setting.checkOnSave.description: After a file is saved, run `check --changed` for its repository and show the findings in **Problems**.
setting.showAllCommands.description: Show the **All commands** view, the tree of every noun, command and resource of every command line. It is hidden by default because **Home** and the views each command line declares are where daily work is; the *Show All Commands* action in Home's `…` menu shows it for this session only.
setting.rowLimit.description: The most rows of one kind a view lists before it says how many more there are. **Find Resource** searches all of them.
